figures.finding: Israeli screen actors are engaged under two agreements between Shaham, the Israeli Actors Guild, and the Israel Film and Television Producers Association: a Film Agreement of 2 August 2006 and a Television Agreement of 24 June 2008, with a National Insurance addendum signed 20 February 2019 that reset the minimum rates.

parties: The Israel Film and Television Producers Association

figures.applies: Israel, Shaham members engaged by Producers Association members in film and television.

sources.said: Entered into and signed on the 24th of June 2008 … And that an Agreement was signed between the Parties on the 2nd of August 2006, regulating the rules of engagement between Performing Artists members of the Shaham Guild and Producers members of the Producers’ Association, in Film Productions as defined in the Agreement

figures.finding: Minimum rates for 2019 are ₪2,340 a filming day for a television actor not in the lead, ₪3,100 for a lead, ₪1,500 a day for a film actor and ₪1,200 for a beginner film actor, all before VAT, indexed to the consumer price index each 15 January in 2020 and 2021; every series must name at least one lead, one of the two Shaham members with the most filming days.

value.indexation: CPI on 15 January 2020 and 2021; later mechanism to be agreed

figures.applies: Israel, contracts signed from 2019-02-01; later CPI-updated tables not found published (see blockers).

figures.finding: A television filming week is six days, Sunday to Friday; a filming day runs up to 10 hours Sunday to Thursday, including a half-hour morning break and an hour for lunch, and up to 8 hours on Friday.
figures.applies: Israel, television productions under the 2008 agreement.

sources.said: 36. A filming week includes 6 days, Sundays to Fridays. 37. The filming day on Sundays to Thursdays will include up to 10 hours, including a half hour morning break and a one hour lunch break. On Fridays the filming day will be up to 8 hours

figures.finding: Productions under the actors' agreement are Hebrew-language: the minimum price list applies to an actor's services to the Hebrew language production.

sources.said: 44. The Producer will pay the Performing Artist, in return for his or her services to the Hebrew language Production, a fee amounting to at least the minimum prices stated in the price list

figures.finding: Tel Aviv is the base the agreement measures from: a filming day in Tel Aviv or within 20 km counts from arrival on set, beyond that from leaving home, and actors in greater Tel Aviv are picked up by the producer; both signatories are in Tel Aviv.

sources.said: 38. When the filming day takes place in Tel Aviv and/or within a radius of up to 20 km of Tel Aviv, the Performing Artist’s number of hours of service provision will be calculated as of the time of the Performing Artist’s arrival at the filming site

25. Actors living within greater Tel Aviv area (up to a radius of 20 km from Tel Aviv) will be picked up by the Producer from their homes, taken to the set and returned home by the Producer at the end of the work day.

figures.finding: Shaham's own pages, read 2026-11-04, give the minimums in force that day (set each year with the producers' association): a television filming day (up to 10 hours) ₪3,872 for a lead and ₪2,923 for any other part; a film day (up to 12 hours) ₪1,509 for any part, ₪1,207 for a beginner (the film page heads its figure 'for 2024'); all before VAT. The pages give no start date, so the game holds them from the day they were read, 2026-11-04, and the 2019 rates before it.

value.basis: in force on the day the pages were read; the pages give no start date

figures.applies: Israel; screen productions under the Shaham–producers agreements.
